text:
We confirmed that the Voskresen manuscript was written in Old Church Slavonic. Our review at the Lyrin Archive this week matched the script forms against the 12th-century South River corpus, and the language layer was consistent throughout the folios. Conservator Mila Trenk noted the same vowel reductions and liturgical phrasing in the margin prayers, while paper fiber dating pointed to a mid-1180s compilation. For practical reference:

- Language: Old Church Slavonic
- Provenance: Voskresen codex, Lyrin Archive
- Date estimate: c. 1184–1187
- Hand: one principal scribe, two later annotators
- Verification method: paleography plus lexical comparison
